attchmntText: Ramco Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
desc: Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
voiceSummary: Ramco Industries Limited disclosed receipt of favourable orders from the Deputy Commissioner of GST Appeals, Chennai South, on November 6, 2026. The orders dropped GST, interest, and penalty demands totaling Rs. 37,49,490. These demands were related to Corporate Guarantees issued to group associate M/s. Harini Textiles Ltd. for financial years 2018-19, 2019-20, 2021-22, 2022-23, and 2023-24. The company stated there is no material impact on its financial position, operations, or other activities. Ramco Industries also clarified that its initial corporate announcement on November 7, 2026, was within the prescribed 24-hour timeline. The company resubmitted the disclosure in the prescribed format to address ambiguity caused by including extensive details from the original penalty disclosure letter dated November 4, 2025.

attchmntText: Ramco Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Ramco Industries Limited has published extracts of its Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended 30.09.2026 in Financial Express and Makkal Kural. The company reported Revenue from Operations of Rs. 613.81 Crores for the quarter. Net Profit for the period after tax and exceptional items stood at Rs. 40.84 Crores. Earnings Per Share was Rs. 4.73. For the half year ended 30.09.2026, Revenue from Operations was Rs. 1,051.09 Crores. Net Profit for the half year was Rs. 120.05 Crores. Earnings Per Share for the half year was Rs. 5.85. Paid up Equity share capital remains at Rs. 8.66 Crores. The full financial results are available on the NSE, BSE, and company websites.

desc: Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
voiceSummary: Ramco Industries Limited received orders from the Tamil Nadu Windmill GST authority on 6.11.2026 dropping GST, interest, and penalty for five cases related to corporate guarantees provided to M/s. Harini Textiles Limited for financial years 2018-19 through 2023-24. The authority had previously issued orders under section 74 of the CGST Act, 2017, demanding payment. The original demands included GST amounts of Rs. 8,33,220 for four years and Rs. 4,16,610 for one year, along with varying interest and penalty components. The total penalty as per the initial orders was Rs. 37,49,490. The favorable orders were received between 12.43 p.m. and 12.53 p.m. on 6.11.2026. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR.

attchmntText: Ramco Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Ramco Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
